name: Finding Chappal Outside Temple / Identical Slippers Confusion
visual_description: A shirtless young man stands with hands on hips, looking helplessly at dozens of identical blue-and-white rubber flip-flops scattered across the floor outside a rack.
usage_context: Used to depict extreme confusion when trying to find one's belongings among identical options, especially relatable to leaving shoes outside temples, mosques, or hostels.

example.top_text: Me outside the temple trying to find the chappal I bought yesterday
